title: Made a short intro cinematic for my AI-assisted city builder / dating sim
author: Kiko_Production
selftext:
Just finished this short intro sequence for a game I’m currently working on.  
The basic idea is a **casual city builder mixed with a dating sim / visual novel**. You start with basically nothing and gradually turn a miserable little settlement into a proper city.  
Different characters will be tied to parts of the city: healthcare, education, business, administration, etc. Building relationships with them will unlock new buildings, upgrades and mechanics, so the dating side is also part of the progression system rather than being completely separate from the city building.  
I’m trying to keep the actual city management relatively accessible instead of going full hardcore SimCity.  
This intro is one of my first attempts at establishing the visual style and character direction. I’m using AI pretty heavily in the art pipeline, then separating assets into layers, fixing them up and animating them in-engine.  
Still very early, but I’m curious what you think about the concept and the visual direction.

Ps: Don’t pay attention to the number of F words, I will change it later.

comments.author: Professional-Mark283
comments.body:
This was actually pretty good! I think it was surprisingly well written and it actually got a good amount of laughs from me. Usually I kinda skim through videos if im not feeling it right away, but this actually had me watching the whole thing. I was going to mention to maybe tone down the amount of swears near the end but it seems you already thought the same as well

I like the visual direction so far, I can tell there's a good amount of effort here, and I really like coolman's design especially, it really stands out in comparison to everything else. Keep it up
